```{r}
## load libraries 
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
## read data 
df_raw <- read_sas("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lx-leong/ec4305_e2_g7/main/data/c9203.sas7bdat")
```

```{r}
# Standardise variable names to lowercase
names(df_raw) <- tolower(names(df_raw))

dim(df_raw)
names(df_raw)
summary(df_raw)
head(df_raw)
```
```{r}
## check for year and age
table(df_raw$year)
range(df_raw$age4, na.rm = TRUE)

# check for data of post 65 and not post 65
with(
  df_raw,
  table(post65, age4 >= 65, useNA = "ifany")
)
```
```{r}
## survey weights 
summary(df_raw$wt)
sum(df_raw$wt == 0, na.rm = TRUE) ## are there any 0 weights
sum(is.na(df_raw$wt)) ## check for na 

```

```{r}
## check values of binary variables 
## Check all relevant binary variables
binary_vars <- c(
  "post65", "mcare", "covered2",
  "sawdr", "inhosp", "goodplus", "poor",
  "female", "wnh", "bnh", "hispanic", "onh",
  "lowed", "emp"
)

# Expected values: 0, 1 or NA
lapply(df_raw[binary_vars], table, useNA = "ifany")
```
```{r}
## Education: inspect years of schooling and missing values
summary(df_raw$educ)
table(df_raw$educ, useNA = "ifany")

## Region: expected categories are 1, 2, 3 and 4
table(df_raw$region, useNA = "ifany")

## Race/ethnicity indicators should sum to 1 for each respondent
race_total <- rowSums(
  df_raw[c("wnh", "bnh", "hispanic", "onh")],
  na.rm = FALSE
)

table(race_total, useNA = "ifany")

## Compare supplied lowed with the definition based on education
with(
  df_raw,
  table(lowed, educ < 12, useNA = "ifany")
)
```


```{r}
# Create analysis variables for 1992–1996.
# Retain original columns and preserve missing observations.
# positive_weight flags usable weights without dropping rows.
df <- df_raw %>%
  filter(between(year, 1992, 1996)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Distance from the eligibility cutoff, in years
    age_c = age4 - 65,

    # Flag usable weights; this does NOT remove observations
    positive_weight = !is.na(wt) & wt > 0,

    # Valid self-rated health categories
    health_clean = if_else(
      health %in% 1:5,
      as.numeric(health),
      NA_real_
    ),

    # Correct poor-health indicator
    poor_clean = if_else(
      is.na(health_clean),
      NA_real_,
      as.numeric(health_clean == 5)
    ),

    # Below high-school education; preserve missing education
    lowed_clean = if_else(
      is.na(educ),
      NA_real_,
      as.numeric(educ < 12)
    ),

    # Categorical versions for later analysis
    region_factor = factor(region),
    year_factor = factor(year)
  )
```

```{r}
## seeing which key vars are missing
key_vars <- c(
  "age4", "post65",
  "mcare", "covered2",
  "sawdr", "inhosp", "goodplus", "poor_clean",
  "female", "wnh", "bnh", "hispanic", "onh",
  "educ", "lowed_clean", "region",
  "year", "wt", "emp"
)

missing_table <- df %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(key_vars), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "n_missing"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_missing = round(100 * n_missing / nrow(df), 2)
  )

print(missing_table, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
## df using only the key variables and dropped na
nhis_clean_full <- df %>%
  filter(year < 1997)
head(nhis_clean_full)
```


```{r}
## downloading cleaned csv
# Save cleaned data
write.csv(
  nhis_clean_full,
  "nhis_clean_full.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Preserve R variable types, including factors, for the EDA
saveRDS(
  nhis_clean_full,
  "nhis_clean_full.rds"
)

write.csv(
  missing_table,
  "missingness_1992_1996.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
